description: This file contains the ConnectionRepository class which manages SSH/SFTP connection data using a ConnectionDao. It provides methods for observing, adding, updating, deleting, and retrieving connections, encapsulating data management logic for connection entities.

classes.name: ConnectionRepository
classes.description: Repository class for managing SSH/SFTP connection data, providing coroutine-based suspend functions and observable flows for connection list.

methods.name: addConnection
methods.description: Adds or replaces a connection with specified parameters, returning the row ID.

methods.name: updateConnection
methods.description: Updates an existing ConnectionEntity in the database.

methods.name: deleteById
methods.description: Deletes a connection entry identified by its primary key id.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a ConnectionEntity by its id, or null if not found.
